subject: food-technology
title: Food Safety
welcome_lead: Storing, cooking and handling food safely.
meta_desc: KS3 food: temperatures, danger zone, cross-contamination.
final_note: Heat or cold keeps food safe.

concepts.def: Date food quality drops, still safe.

walkthroughs.body_html: The fridge runs below 5°C. The freezer sits below -18°C. Bacteria don't die in cold — they sleep. Once warm again they restart.
Heat food right through to at least 75°C (cooked food's centre). Check chicken juices run clear. Don't reheat the same dish more than once.
Defrost meat in the fridge overnight — not on the counter. Once defrosted, cook within 24 hours and don't re-freeze it raw.
